meta.title: Fly Roulette
meta.description: Cartoon flies pass a toy cap gun around the table. Each fly's real 166,700-neuron connectome, running in your browser, decides: squeeze the trigger or fly off. Last fly standing wins.

head.title: Fly Roulette
head.sub: A toy cap gun goes round the table. Each fly's real brain decides: squeeze the trigger or fly off. Last fly at the table wins.

bet.title: Play for $FLYAI
bet.intro: Back a fly with real $FLYAI. If it's the last fly at the table, you win your stake times the number of flies, less 5%.
bet.depositLabel: Send $FLYAI from your wallet to your balance
bet.withdrawLabel: Ask for $FLYAI back to your wallet
bet.withdrawNote: Withdrawals are sent by hand, usually within a day.
bet.toPassNote: Moves the amount to your FlightPass balance right now. From the pass, withdrawals are sent automatically (1% fee).
bet.toPassOk: ✓ {amount} FLYAI moved to FlightPass #{id}; withdraw it on the FlightPass page
bet.how1: Free play stays free. "Spin the drum" never touches money; betting is only this panel.
bet.how2: You against the house. Every seat wins 1 time in n. A win pays stake × n × 0.95; the 5% is the house edge.
bet.how3: Your balance is the same $FLYAI balance compute orders use: deposits, winnings and order refunds all land in it, and any of it can be bet, spent on orders or withdrawn.
bet.how4: Separate from the miners' pool. Bets don't earn compute points, don't change anyone's share of the monthly pool, and no stakes or house edge go into it. The house edge stays with fly.ai.
bet.how5: Provably fair. The server commits to its seed before your bet and reveals it after; "Verify this game" replays it on your own fly brains.
bet.pickNone: tap a fly to back its seat
bet.withdrawAsked: You asked for {amount} FLYAI back; it's sent by hand, usually within a day.
bet.cancelOk: ✓ request cancelled; the amount is free in your balance again

terms.title: Before your first bet
terms.t1: You bet real $FLYAI from your balance. You can lose all of it.
terms.t2: Each fly at the table is equally likely to win. A win pays your stake times the number of flies, less a 5% house edge.
terms.t3: The server plays the game: it commits to its seed before your bet and reveals it after, so you can check every game.
terms.t4: Winnings go to your balance. Withdrawals are sent by hand and can take a day.
terms.t5: Betting may be illegal where you live. It's your responsibility to follow your local laws.
terms.accept: I accept the terms
